translations.web: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
translations.bsb: For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.
translations.kjv: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
translations.asv: For he shall see it. Wise men die; The fool and the brutish alike perish, And leave their wealth to others.
